## The dissertation question (for your channel/source judgments)
How does an individual's chance of advancement (being selected into a scarce position, e.g., promotion) depend on their environment? Environment = peers + organization. It acts through three channels: DEVELOPMENT (what the person becomes), EVALUATION (how their performance is measured/perceived, e.g., ratings relative to peers), SELECTION (who wins a scarce slot; selection is its own step: score, then select top K). The dissertation does NOT presume an inverted U or causal peer effects. Gaps must be built from specific limitations of studies, tagged: [small data] [imperfect measure] [single system] [no model of mechanism] [model not fit to data] [outcome is not selection].
